description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides mechanisms for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration functionalities. It also includes nested classes and methods for buffer cursor management, synchronization, and buffer validation.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a process-wide shared cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration capabilities.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested class within CyclicBuffer that manages cursor position and data peeking within the buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with a filename, mode, size, and overwrite flag.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(Core::DataElementFile& buffer, const bool initiator, const uint32_t offset, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with an existing data element file.

methods.name: DataAvailable()
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock(bool dataPresent = false, const uint32_t waitTime = Core::infinite)
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek(uint8_t buffer[], const uint32_t length) const
methods.description: Non-destructive read of data from the buffer.

methods.name: Read(uint8_t buffer[], const uint32_t length, bool partialRead = false)
methods.description: Destructive read, advancing the tail pointer.

methods.name: Write(const uint8_t buffer[], const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head pointer.

methods.name: Reserve(const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing.
